raw_frame.note: p1-p99 only 23 m; extremes are SLAM flyaway outliers

coverage: shallow ~23 m vertical section around the 3 skylights; does NOT reach the deep tube (first_long_flight spans z 166-250, ~80 m). Adds no deep tau coverage.

match_6dof.verdict: fits skylights well but tilts gravity by 46.7 deg -> converts the ~200 m section into a 100 m vertical span, inconsistent with the tube 11 deg grade. Unphysical roll (near-collinear skylights leave roll unconstrained).

match_4dof.verdict: gravity-preserving fit cannot reconcile all 3 skylights (one off 5.3 m) -> residual vertical drift or wrong-twin-hole pick.

conclusion: second_long_flight is NOT a clean tau basis: cannot register preserving gravity AND fitting 3 skylights. Use it for mission metrics (T7) and as a drift datapoint (T6, ~5 m skylight non-coplanarity). first_long_flight + full-extent DEM (T3) remains the primary tau reconstruction.
